retro:
# Retrospective

## Worked

Read-only security triage preceded reviewer resets and PR execution. Managed Team 5 context and exact pane ownership were verified first. Both reviewers received equivalent neutral scope, current corrections, separate storage and explicit independence constraints. Actual Claude Code Opus 5.5 High and Pi GPT 6 Sol Xhigh native identities are recorded. Independent finals were both saved before report reading. One small isolated Node run demonstrated the new test's useful discrimination; source assessment bounded the remaining native/UI uncertainty without inventing findings.

## Friction and deviations

Source acquisition copied an incomplete local object repository. Initial checkout failed due to missing blobs; raw failure retained. Full upstream refetch and successful clean checkout corrected it before reviewers started. No source completeness claim relies on the failed checkout.

Fixture process deviations: missing individual status gates for exit-receipt writes and final summary write; cat within the core-limit comparison not independently gated. Intermediate directory creation and generated sed temp paths were covered by private root reasoning rather than literal per-final-target assertions. Raw retained files and checked test exits are valid for the narrow test outcomes; do not call this fully guard-compliant. No invalid run was deleted. Private writes stayed within the run output root. Native automatic session history lives in standard runtime storage and was preserved.

During a lifecycle check, Sol's completed headline was visible in pane output before Opus finished, although the complete Sol report was not read until both final reports existed. No conclusion was passed to either reviewer and synthesis waited for both finals. Future completed-agent checks should inspect status and final-file presence only, avoiding pane prose unless resolving a blocker.

## Corrections for this assignment and subsequent fixtures

Explicitly check receipt and summary redirections immediately, gate each producer in command substitution and pipelines, enumerate mkdir subpaths, and avoid unconstrained generated sed temp names by using a preasserted explicit output file followed by a guarded move. Require independent expected-content checks before summary generation. Assignment-local PROCESS-CORRECTIONS.md is augmented with these exact reminders. Future reviewer launch instructions should preserve these corrections. No need to extend runtime testing for already resolved source logic solely to repair a nontechnical summary gate; preserve and qualify current evidence instead.

## Tools and scope

No confirmed Omadev/tool bug. Node exists through Mise rather than /usr/bin, so Opus copied the executable into the fixture and verified its version within isolation. A shared pinned tool provision could reduce repeated binary copies. No desktop slot was used, no persistent reviewer memory edited, no upstream action, and no browser preview opened. Reviewers are done and retained in their owned panes; synchronous sandbox execution completed with no surviving owned runtime resource reported.
comment:
**Verified:** No actionable defect was found in the font-selection logic at `df8f1d63`. The bar selects an installed Propo sibling without changing the shared shell or terminal font configuration.

| Selected family | Matching Propo installed | Bar selection |
|---|---|---|
| Nerd Font / Nerd Font Mono, or NF / NFM | Yes | Installed Propo / NFP sibling |
| No matching sibling or unrelated family | No | Original shared family, preserving the `monospace` alias |

The added test passed all 17 assertions. It evaluates the actual `Bar.qml` binding with synthetic font-family data; separate diagnostic changes removing alias fallback or resolved-family selection both caused the expected assertion failure.

---
## Review information

**Test scope:** Source inspection and the Node test with two diagnostic controls. Actual Qt font enumeration, live font switching, rendered glyph widths, clipping and fractional scaling were not independently tested.

**Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Automated AI review:** Astra Medium initial inspection, independent Opus 5.5 High and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments, then Astra Medium synthesis against source and targeted test evidence. A fresh Astra Medium check assessed presentation and disclosures only.
